material.acceptance_criteria: A CI job where a peer orders a foreign unit and asserts that unit's position is unchanged.
material.description: The host rejects an order whose unit player differs from the sending peer's player; js/host/server.js data handler forwards any unit, and rust/crates/wasip1 order takes no player.
material.subject: Node host forwards any peer's order to any unit
